name: Sinks Canyon State Park (Sawmill Campground)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-20: Esri World_Imagery (90 m half-width, 0.225 m/px, and 450 m) and USGS NAIP (imagery.nationalmap.gov USGSNAIPImagery, 90 m, same EPSG:3857 frame) plus USGS 3DEP DEM in the identical frame, every reserve.wyoming.gov unit point (FacilityId 385 MapInfo) plotted; all images rendered. The Middle Fork Popo Agie runs as a boulder cascade along the south side of the loop, ~12-18 m of whitewater (NAIP) between the campground bank and the canyon's south wall (DEM floor ~40-45 m bank to wall) -> creek-size (<30 m). Unit points: 28 (42.75703,-108.79960) and 29 (42.75697,-108.79981) on the paved parallel roadside lane at the bank; whitewater edge ~8-12 m south of the points, the bank dropping ~2 m (DEM 1876.8/1877.8 -> 1874.5-1875); 27 (42.75715,-108.79932) ~20 m; 26 'Short Walk' ~20-25 m; tent TE25 north-east by the shelter. Between the 28/29 lane and the water both imagery vintages show a continuous band of riparian trees ~8-10 m deep (Esri crowns overhang the lane; RGB transects from 28 and 29 run green for 8-12 m before rock/water, with no open gap confirmed). Not the open ground the on-water value needs (gate defaults down), so not creekside; the cascade is in view through the trees from the shoulder sites: The Dyrt listing 'around six sites running directly alongside the river', a 2018 Dyrt reviewer 'right on the drive and next to a cascade in a deep canyon', and the engine tags 27, 28, 29 'Waterfront Setting: River' (type-level, measured here) -> riverview (filtered view from 27-29). Lead: creekside if a site photo shows open ground from 28/29 to the water (Popo Agie's 03-05 passed through a low willow fringe).
inclusion_evidence: reserve.wyoming.gov (US eDirect API wyordr.usedirect.com/wyomingrdr/rdr/, PlaceId 15 'Sinks Canyon State Park'), FacilityId 385 'Sawmill' (facility point 42.7573,-108.7991), search/grid + search/details read 2026-11-20: 4 web-bookable 'Campsite Non-Electric' units (IsRVSite true): 26 ('Unit & Parking Size(ft)' 20, gravel back-in), 27 (24, paved back-in, 24x15), 28 and 29 (40, paved, 40x9; 'Angle to Road: Parallel', 'Pull Through RV Site', 'Will not accommodate RV slide-outs.'); tent site TE25 (24x10, drive-in); day-use Shelter SAWS ($40 'Day Use'); Rate 10.00 Nightly on 2027-07-14 and Saturday 2027-07-17; MaximumStay 14 -> real drive-in RV campground; a 23-ft rig fits 27, 28 and 29 (slide-outs not at 28/29). Wyoming State Parks 'Campsites for RVs' page (wyoparks.wyo.gov/index.php/activities-amenities-sinks-canyon/campsites-for-rvs-sinks-canyon, read as search-result text 2026-11-20; the site answers an F5 challenge): 'Sawmill Campground offers 5 campsites with an accessible site, 2 roadside trailer/camper sites and 2 pull in/tent sites.' The Dyrt (thedyrt.com/camping/wyoming/sawmill-campground, read 2026-11-20): first campground in Sinks Canyon, mainly a day-use area with a large picnic shelter; listing 'RVs are limited to 24 feet' (aggregator; the engine's 40-ft roadside sites outrank it); 2017 reviewer 'best for vans or small campers'. Imagery 2026-11-20: a paved loop on the south side of WY-131 with its own connections to the highway, ~2.4 km by road below Popo Agie's entrance, the shelter, a vault toilet and the shoulder pads at the unit points. 2.56 km from Popo Agie RV-site centroid to centroid (nearest units 2.36 km). Not in the DB before (split from 6359 Sinks Canyon State Park, 2026-11-20). Public (state): no price gate.
note: Sawmill is the first campground up Sinks Canyon from Lander, a small loop that is mostly a day-use area with a large picnic shelter; its campsites sit on the shoulder of the loop above the Middle Fork Popo Agie's cascade. Site 27 (24 ft) and the two parallel roadside sites 28 and 29 take a 23-ft rig; 28 and 29 will not take slide-outs, and site 26 is 20 ft. --Claude

facilities.note: A hand pump, shut off in the off season.

season.note: Off season (Oct 1 - Apr 30) access depends on the weather.

booking.note: Reservations May 1 - Sep 30; first-come the rest of the year.

fees.note: Wyoming's statewide schedule: the base camping rate plus sales & lodging tax per vehicle; Sinks Canyon charges no day-use fee.
